'''Duster''' is the name of [[Banner-General]] [[Tylee Khirgan]]'s warhorse.

==Appearance==
Duster is a tall bay horse.

==Activities==
Duster carries Tylee to a meeting with [[Perrin Aybara]].{{ref/book|11|4}} When Perrin goes to [[Almizar]] to gather ''[[raken]]'', [[forkroot]], and ''[[a'dam]]'', Tylee accompanies him on Duster.{{ref/book|11|12}} After the [[Battle of Malden]], the banner-general proudly displays [[Sevanna]] across Duster's saddle.{{ref/book|11|30}} When [[Trolloc]]s attack the [[Seanchan]] group, Duster screams and throws Tylee from his saddle.{{ref/book|12|Prologue}}
